progress.deployedBuild: API ECS rev 73 (image 20261005T155241Z-70251b7); UI Amplify job #104 @ 4c3afc1
progress.results: Checked in the browser, not only against the API. All six search pages - Awards, Historical Awards, Proposals, Negotiations, Subawards and Global Search - showed the validation guidance for a query carrying a hidden control character, and a structured sponsor filter carrying one showed the same. An ordinary 250-character Global Search, which the API refuses with the same code for a different reason, showed that guidance too and claimed no invisible-character cause. None of the eight showed the old “try again in a moment” wording. Correcting the search restored results: 105698 and *105698* each returned 2 awards found, 105698-00001 and 105698-00002.
progress.limitations: The guidance is deliberately general because the API returns one shared code for several different causes, so it says where to look rather than naming one. The Global Search length limit itself is unchanged and remains TC-018.
